blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Pinned Plume block 96626677: the BoringVault owner remains the 3-of-6 Safe and hook() is zero. The verified source nevertheless permits the owner to setBeforeTransferHook(address) through requiresAuth; transfers and transferFrom invoke the configured hook's beforeTransfer(from), which can reject a holder's transfer. Yes denotes this configurable holder restriction, not an assertion that a blacklist hook is currently installed. Separate OFAC mint-gateway checks do not alone establish holder freezing.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: The authored Ethereum and Plume pUSD rows are native BoringVault deployments owned by the same Plume/Nucleus Safe. Current issuer docs additionally describe bridge-and-mint with USDC and cross-chain redemption pending up to 12 hours. That operational path and legacy USDC.e held in the Plume vault are separate from a claim that pUSD itself is a third-party bridge representation. No exhaustive material wrapper/deployment census or bridge-role graph is established by the two token owner reads.

controls.label: pUSD Ethereum Teller LayerZero credit and debit
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26098751, vault() returns the pUSD BoringVault, canCall(Teller,vault,enter) is true and peers(30370) is the same Teller address on Plume. Verified _lzReceive calls vault.enter with zero collateral; bridge send calls vault.exit with zero collateral. Pinned effective ULN configs require all three DVNs 0x589dedbd617e0cbcb916a9223f4d1300c294236b, 0xa4fe5a5b9a846458a70cd0748228aed3bf65c2cd and 0xa59ba433ac34d2927232918ef5b2eaafcf130ba5, with zero optional DVNs, 15 send confirmations and 5 receive confirmations. Validator operator independence, message limits and in-flight supply reconciliation are not established. Native collateral deposits are assessed separately.
